name: Hoffmann V60

steps.label: Bloom to 60g
steps.detail: Pour 2× the dose, swirl to wet all grounds

steps.label: Pour to 500g
steps.detail: Finish by 1:45, gentle stir, then a light swirl

steps.label: Drawdown
steps.detail: Let it drain flat — aim to finish around 3:30

notes: James Hoffmann's Ultimate V60 technique. Use water just off the boil for light roasts.
